sql: SELECT s.School, s.DOC FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM schools s2 JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded');
SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3 FROM satscores sat JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.Charter = 0 AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18;

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS count FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND s.GSserved = 'K-8' AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY s.City;
SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmEmail2 FROM schools s WHERE s.County = 'San Bernardino' AND s.City = 'San Bernardino' AND s.DOC = '54' AND s.SOC = '62' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31';
SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS max_ratio FROM satscores sat JOIN frpm f ON sat.cds = f.CDSCode WHERE sat.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sat.NumTstTakr > 0.3;
SELECT s.School, s.Street FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;
SELECT f.`School Name` FROM frpm f JOIN satscores sat ON f.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1 AND sat.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT sat.sname, f.`Charter Funding Type` FROM satscores sat JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.District LIKE 'Riverside%' AND s.District IN (SELECT s2.District FROM satscores sat2 JOIN schools s2 ON sat2.cds = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.District LIKE 'Riverside%' GROUP BY s2.District HAVING AVG(sat2.AvgScrMath) > 400);

SELECT f.`School Name`, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey' AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)' AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;
SELECT s.School, sat.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone FROM schools s LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01';
SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS ratio FROM frpm f ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM satscores sat JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE sat.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT s.CharterNum, sat.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM satscores sat JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE sat.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;
